title: Animal Groups
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Animal Groups Worksheets (Fish, Amphibians, Reptiles, Birds, Mammals)
standard_text: Identify and name a variety of common animals including fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals. Describe and compare the structure of a variety of common animals.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on animal groups: fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals, their features, and tricky animals like whales, bats and penguins. 100 questions with answers.
key_big: Animals can be sorted into groups.
key_sub: Sort animals by features such as fur, feathers and scales.
body_html:
How to think about it

Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.

  • Fish have fins and scales. Birds have feathers.
  • Mammals have fur and feed their babies milk.
  • Amphibians have damp skin; reptiles have dry, scaly skin.
Example

A robin is a?

Feathers and a beak

Answer: bird

Example

A whale is a?

Breathes air, feeds milk

Answer: mammal

Common mistakes

  • Thinking a whale is a fish.
  • Thinking a bat is a bird.
  • Thinking a penguin is not a bird.

faq.q: What are the main animal groups?
faq.a: Fish, amphibians, reptiles, birds and mammals.

faq.q: How do I know which group an animal is in?
faq.a: Look at its features. Birds have feathers; mammals have fur and feed babies milk; fish have fins, scales and gills; reptiles have dry scales; amphibians have damp skin.
No. A whale is a mammal. It breathes air and feeds its babies milk.
